submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 with a 35 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency (94.028%) at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. This was determined through systematic simulation scans across all three candidate algorithms and multiple threshold values (20-60 GeV range). Algorithm-L1 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) consistently outperformed Algorithm-L3 (85.4% at 35 GeV) and Algorithm-L2 (73.6% at 40 GeV). The 35 GeV threshold represents the optimal operating point for Algorithm-L1, with nearby thresholds showing lower efficiency: 34 GeV (91.9%), 34.5 GeV (91.5%), 35.5 GeV (93.0%), 36 GeV (92.0%). All candidate algorithms meet the hardware constraints (FPGA resources, bandwidth), making performance the decisive factor.
